scripts.dev:api: cd apps/api && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.lint:api: cd apps/api && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.format: prettier --write . && cd apps/api && uv run ruff format .
scripts.format:check: prettier --check . && cd apps/api && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.typecheck:api: cd apps/api && uv run mypy app
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.db:migrate: cd apps/api && uv run alembic upgrade head
scripts.db:downgrade: cd apps/api && uv run alembic downgrade -1
scripts.db:seed: cd apps/api && uv run python -m app.cli seed
scripts.contracts:export: cd apps/api && uv run python -m app.cli export-openapi ../../packages/contracts/openapi.json
